audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 2, 3 and 5 disagreed with the packet and with the page's own whys — the chart gave Ornn level 3 while whys[2] says 'She owns this window', and gave Ornn the first-item stage while whys[5] says her first-item snowball beats your pre-tank-item body.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill / Skill / Irelia / Skill / Irelia / Irelia / Ornn; the mirror (irelia__ornn) flipped exactly these four rows as matched pairs, rating even stages 5/10 and Irelia's stages 7/10 from her side.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 5 flipped as one atomic group across both layers; ratings set to 5,5,3,5,3,3,7 from your side.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why claimed the first-item stage as your spike; no cooldown appeared anywhere, and packet.defects notes no Irelia ability is named in the content layer.
audit.why: Flawless Duet 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Bladesurge 10s at rank 1 with a refresh on Marked targets and kills, Defiant Dance 20s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: phases[2].why, phases[5].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d rewritten with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. Volcanic Rupture grounds Bladesurge, which is her dash, her reset and her escape from your pillar — never stated. And Flawless Duet only stuns enemies caught between the two converging blades, not anywhere in its area.
audit.why: Ornn Q carries grounding; Irelia Q carries dash. Riot's E text: 'two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.'
audit.corrected: Grounding written into report[5].t; the converge condition into dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] says she 'shreds your armor with passive true-damage'. Ionian Fervor grants stacking attack speed and, at max stacks, bonus on-hit damage — no true damage and no resist shred.
audit.why: Riot's passive text. The mirror flagged the same 'resist shred' fiction from the other side; what actually beats Living Forge resists is max-stack attack speed plus percent-HP item damage.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[2] rewritten to max-stack Ionian Fervor.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Irelia must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Her window: Bladesurge resets off minions and Flawless Duet stuns at 16s, and you have no answer to either yet.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Flawless Duet's cooldown.
edits.after: Her duelist first item lands before your tank item does — hold the wave and farm to your second.

edits.before: - Irelia Flawless Duet: matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Irelia Flawless Duet: 16s at rank 1, 10s maxed — the stun lands only between the blades. - Bladesurge: 10s, refreshed by a Marked target or a kill. - Defiant Dance: 20s, cuts physical damage mid-charge.

edits.before: Her engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1. It stuns only between the two blades, so step aside.

edits.before: Track Irelia's Flawless Duet (Stun): Her engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — W-E + R her.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture grounds Bladesurge — no dash out, no reset, and your charge lands.

edits.before: Get going early so she out-scales into a duelist who shreds your armor with passive true-damage
edits.after: Get going early so she out-scales into a duelist whose max-stack Ionian Fervor grinds through resists

notes: Unverified and left standing: this entry credits Bellows Breath with a shield in six places (whys[2], spikes[1], early, mid, wants.you[1], phases text) and calls it 'unstoppable'. Riot's W text is one sentence — 'Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle' — with no shield and no unstoppable, and the kit flags carry neither. The mirror audit flagged the same fiction from Irelia's side ('shield that heals'). I did not delete these because a shield's existence is exactly the kind of thing the kit file cannot settle, but it is load-bearing for the advice 'she can't Q-reset on you for free anymore' and should be checked against the Wiki before the next pass.
